title: TelemetryRankingV1
description: The telemetry_ranking listing, version 1. agent-swarm stores it stringified in the global swarm_config key telemetry_ranking and sends the same string as the listing property of ranking.opted_in. The string must not exceed 2048 bytes. The ingest also requires name to equal context.org_name and domain to equal context.org_website. Text fields are trimmed before their length is checked; lengths count UTF-16 code units, as JavaScript does.

v.description: Listing version. A new version is a new schema file, never an edit to this one.

claim.description: Optional and ignored. agent-swarm v2.4.0 mints it for a ranking PR flow that no longer exists; the proxy still checks its pattern when present, but ranks from telemetry alone. Never served publicly.

name.description: Copied from SWARM_ORG_NAME. Served as app.title.

domain.description: Copied from SWARM_ORG_WEBSITE: a lowercase hostname without scheme, path or port. Served as app.slug.

category.description: A key of taxonomy.json. Served as the group filter.

subcategory.description: One of taxonomy.json's subcategories for category, or null. Served as app.categories.

description.description: Optional one-line description. Served as app.description.

sourceCodeUrl.description: Optional https URL. Served as app.source_code_url.

updatedAt.description: When the install built this listing, in UTC with a Z suffix.
